userStories.title: Per-session ring buffer with replay on reconnect (backend)
userStories.description: As a user, I want missed output replayed after a disconnect so I don't lose context when the connection drops.

userStories.notes: Done 2026-05-25. Refactored src/terminal/index.ts into a persistent pty-session registry (Map<id,TermSession>): pty + onData/onExit wired once and outlive any single WS. Each session keeps a ring buffer of recent output capped to RING_MAX_BYTES (default 256KB, override CONAN_TERM_RING_BYTES) with oldest chunks evicted. A client opts into survival by passing a stable ?tid=; on reconnect the buffered backlog is replayed as one frame BEFORE session.ws is reassigned (synchronous, so no live chunk interleaves), then live output resumes on the SAME pty. On WS close a persistent session survives a grace window (DETACH_GRACE_MS default 30s, override CONAN_TERM_GRACE_MS) then is killed; anonymous (no-tid) sessions die on close as before. closeAllTerminals() wired into gateway shutdown. Client (ui/Terminal.tsx) now generates+persists a per-tab tid in sessionStorage so a reload/HMR re-attaches+replays instead of spawning fresh (bonus: mitigates dogfooding footgun #2). Verified: scripts/test-terminal.mjs (in npm test) boots the real gateway against a fake $SHELL — 10/10 checks: pty survives disconnect, reconnect replays backlog as first frame (incl. earlier START) before live OUT:BBB resumes, ring stays within the byte cap with OUT:L0 evicted + OUT:L40 retained. typecheck + full npm test + ui build all clean.

userStories.notes: Done 2026-05-25. Backend: src/settings/index.ts (JSON store at .data/settings.json, CONAN_SETTINGS_PATH override; coerces ceilings to a positive number or null=no-limit) + src/budget/index.ts (budgetStatus() evaluates the per-day + per-session ceilings against session.total_cost_usd — costToday mirrors the hero Cost-today window; canLaunchSession() is the throttle gate, no-op unless throttleOverBudget is on AND the daily ceiling is crossed). Gateway: GET /api/claude/budget (read-only), PUT /api/claude/settings/budget (x-conan-token; accepts daily_cost_ceiling_usd/per_session_cost_ceiling_usd/throttle_over_budget), POST /api/claude/sessions returns 429 over_budget when the gate blocks, and onSessionEvent re-checks the budget after each cost-folding event — on a fresh crossing it broadcasts a synthetic Notification event so the toast fires and the widget refetches (the optional Notification channel). UI: hooks/useBudget.ts (refetch on each WS event seq + token-gated save), components/BudgetPanel.tsx (cost-today vs daily ceiling progress bar, per-session overage list, destructive 'Over budget' alert header when crossed, inline editor for both ceilings + the throttle checkbox), wired into App.tsx below pending-approvals. Verified: scripts/test-budget.mjs (in npm test) boots the real gateway against an isolated DB+settings, seeds $12.30 across two sessions, and round-trips all of it — 14/14 checks: PUT auth 401, costToday aggregate, dailyPct, under/over daily, per-session overage detect/exclude, 429 throttle when over + reason, 200 launch when throttle off, raising the ceiling clears overBudget, on-disk persistence. Browser (automate-browser, light+dark, scripts/verify-budget.mjs on :3770): over-budget panel shows red 'Over budget' badge + full red $12.30/$10.00 bar + 'claude-opus-4-7 over per-session limit $7.80'; Edit reveals the seeded ceilings ($10/$5, throttle checked) + Save. typecheck + ui build + full npm test all clean.
